summary: The Lakehouse Engineer designs, implements, and maintains modern data lakehouse architectures that combine the features of data lakes and data warehouses.
responsibilities: Implement lakehouse platforms using Delta Lake, Apache Hudi, or Iceberg
Build ETL/ELT pipelines for batch and streaming data
Optimize storage, query performance, and scalability
Ensure data governance, security, and consistency
Support analytics, BI, and ML workloads

education: 4–7 years of experience in modern big data architectures

skills_required.name: Expertise in lakehouse frameworks (Delta Lake, Hudi, Iceberg)
Strong SQL, Python, or Scala programming
Knowledge of Spark, Flink, or other distributed engines
Cloud experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP
